exposure: Patient and clinician knowledge of the calculated cesarean delivery risk score based on the validated calculator
implementation of a validated calculator that predicts the likelihood of cesarean delivery at the time of labor induction
cohort: 1610 women admitted for labor induction with singleton gestation in cephalic presentation, intact membranes, and an unfavorable cervix
finding: Implementation of a validated calculator to predict risk of cesarean delivery in clinical care is associated with reduced maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Calculator implementation was also associated with a decrease in cesarean delivery rate.
